import pathlib
import sys
import unittest


sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).parent))
import reparse  # noqa: E402


class TargetPlayerDrawTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def map_draw(self, text):
        verb, args = reparse.O.parse_atom(text)
        self.assertEqual(verb, "p_draw")
        return reparse.map_atom(verb, args, kind="oneshot")

    def test_target_player_draws(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            self.map_draw("Target player draws a card."),
            ("draw", {"amount": 1}, {"filter": "player"}),
        )

    def test_target_opponent_draws(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            self.map_draw("Target opponent draws a card."),
            ("draw", {"amount": 1, "target": "opponent"}, None),
        )

    def test_each_opponent_draws(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            self.map_draw("Each opponent draws a card."),
            ("draw", {"amount": 1, "target": "opponent"}, None),
        )

    def test_each_player_draws_is_unmapped(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.map_draw("Each player draws a card."))

    def test_that_player_draws_is_unmapped(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.map_draw("That player draws a card."))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
